description: Whisper speech-to-text inference benchmark using HuggingFace WhisperForConditionalGeneration. Encodes mel-spectrogram input and generates text tokens. Reports tokens/sec throughput.

scaling_param.name: num_new_tokens
scaling_param.description: Maximum number of new tokens to generate from audio input

non_scaling_params.name: batch
non_scaling_params.description: Number of audio samples in a batch

non_scaling_params.name: time_frames
non_scaling_params.description: Number of mel-spectrogram time frames (audio duration)
